title: Zesty Char-Grilled Chicken Sandwich
description: A lazy Sunday Turkish dish featuring roasted chicken with a dash of dashi and char-grill-yang for added texture and flavor.
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
In a mixing bowl, combine butter, rice vinegar, sesame oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, and finely chopped shallots. Mix until well combined.
Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper on both sides. Apply the sauce mixture evenly over the chicken, making sure it's fully coated.
Place the chicken on the preheated grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Let rest for a minute before slicing into strips.
Serve hot with your favorite bread and condiments.
